Open the generated IDML in InDesign and continue editing normally.

posts.name: Cookie — Keep the good bits.
posts.tagline: Collect text and screenshots. Send the full context.
posts.description: Cookie is a small Mac companion that helps you collect selected text and original screenshots from across your apps. Review everything in one Jar, remove what you don’t need, then send the complete context into the conversation you’re already having. Cookie is currently available through a closed beta for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later.

posts.name: Axon Equity
posts.tagline: Institutional equity research powered by GPT-6 Astra
posts.description: Axon Equity is an institutional US equity research workspace powered by GPT-6 Astra. By leveraging Astra's 1M+ token context and deep reasoning, it eliminates financial hallucinations from RAG chunking. It ingests full SEC 10-K/10-Q filings to verify 8-quarter cross-period financials and generate structured Decision Matrices with bull/bear evidence chains. Public charts, trends, and Sankey profit flows are free to explore. Sign in to test live multi-step Astra reasoning.

posts.name: SquishyFile Video Filters
posts.tagline: VHS filter & video effects, live in your browser
posts.description: SquishyFile's video filter tool applies a real VHS look — scanlines, tracking noise, tape warmth — or one of four artistic styles (pencil sketch, cross-hatch, thermal vision, neon cyberpunk), rendered live by a WebGL shader right in your browser. Ten styles total, six of them VHS/camcorder presets from different eras. Preview any style on your own clip before committing, then export an MP4 with the effect baked in and your original audio intact.

posts.name: Bay Avenue Dental Centre, Dubai
posts.tagline: dental clinic in dubai
posts.description: Bay Avenue Dental Centre is a trusted dental clinic in Business Bay, Dubai, known for delivering comprehensive dental care using modern technology and patient-focused treatment planning. The clinic offers a wide range of services, including Dental Implants, Pediatric Dentistry, Clear Aligners, Orthodontic Braces, Cosmetic Dentistry, teeth whitening, Root Canal Treatment, and Gum Disease Treatment, all under one roof.

posts.name: Finly Calculator
posts.tagline: Financial decisions, calculated.
posts.description: Free financial calculators for mortgage, retirement, and investing decisions. Clear comparisons, transparent assumptions, and no account required.

posts.name: RankArena
posts.tagline: Discover Products Competing for Attention
posts.description: RankArena is a competitive product leaderboard where products battle for attention. Submit your product, choose an arena, bid for position, challenge competitors, and defend your rank. Build a public history of rankings, #1 streaks, outbids, comebacks, and achievements. Track impressions, views, and outbound clicks to see what your position actually delivers. Every climb becomes part of your product’s story.

posts.name: Sonnex
posts.tagline: A modern, direct DAW for macOS
posts.description: Sonnex is a macOS DAW built around a more direct music-making workflow. Instead of constantly jumping between separate windows and panels, the goal is to keep the tools you need close at hand in one unified workspace. Record, edit, work with MIDI, instruments, effects and mixing tools without getting lost in the interface. Built independently and still evolving based on real user feedback.

posts.name: Softsky 2.0 - Curated 4K Wallpapers
posts.tagline: Handcrafted 4K wallpapers & daily auto-changer for Android
posts.description: Softsky 2.0 is a complete overhaul of your Android wallpaper experience. Explore curated 4K & AMOLED collections, wide formats for foldables, an automated daily wallpaper changer, and a brand-new Creator Collective where artists can share their designs.

posts.name: TreeTalk Node
posts.tagline: Private file sharing and messaging. Android + Windows.
posts.description: Local-first file sharing and messaging for Android and Windows. Send files, photos, videos, text and PTT-style voice over Wi-Fi, LAN, hotspot or VPN, with no cloud relay or account required for ordinary local use. No cloud server or internet required.

posts.name: TinySlate
posts.tagline: Stop paying monthly to find your own footage
posts.description: Hundreds of hours of footage, and you can never find the clip you need. TinySlate is a Mac app that uses AI or Apple's on-device models to tag your clips so you can search them like Spotlight. Most tools like this are built for studios — cloud, subscriptions, team seats. TinySlate's for solo shooters: footage stays on your Mac, no subscription, $45 once. Send your cut to FCP, Premiere, or Resolve.

posts.name: Vangrex
posts.tagline: Design, execute, and integrate AI workflows
posts.description: Vangrex is a developer-first platform for building and running AI workflows visually. Design workflows on a visual canvas, connect AI models and tools, add logic and data flow, and execute them without building the orchestration layer from scratch. Use the Vangrex SDK to integrate your workflows into your own applications. 🚀 Vangrex is currently in private beta and we're looking for developers to try it, build real workflows, and help shape what comes next.

posts.name: Nor Abon
posts.tagline: Build SaaS apps with JSON schemas instead of custom code
posts.description: Nor Abon is a schema-driven framework for building SaaS applications. Define your database, objects, actions, pages, and UI with JSON schemas instead of writing custom code for every feature. It includes a schema-driven admin panel, CRUD, permissions, reusable actions, and Docker-based development. Built for indie developers and small teams.

posts.name: Shake Social — Meet Real People
posts.tagline: Spontaneous, real-world connections with real people.
posts.description: SHAKE Launch MilestonesSoft-Launch V1 (Nov 2025): Initial market entry in Lisbon and Medellín, establishing 1,000+ app downloads and an audience of 3,000+ Instagram followers. Soft-Launch V2 (July 2026): Target release in Medellín, securing 300 downloads around the July 21 timeframe. Launch V3 (September 2026): The current deployment phase, expanding on user feedback from V1 and V2 to scale active host communities and user engagement.

posts.name: Linkary
posts.tagline: Turn online influence into measurable growth
posts.description: Linkary is an identity, attribution and growth platform for founders, startups, creators and communities. Build a professional public profile, showcase your work, products and digital assets, measure campaign contributions, track engagement and traffic, and monetize your audience. Linkary connects activity across social, community and digital channels to help people understand who creates value, what drives growth and where that growth comes from.

posts.name: Quiet Orbit
posts.tagline: Block your apps. Every focused minute flies you to a planet
posts.description: Most focus timers log your time and forget it. Quiet Orbit flies it: every focused minute moves your ship along one route of 11 worlds, Earth to Pluto. Finish a session and bring back a finding: an object, a record or a sound. You pick which apps stay blocked.

posts.name: veldetector
posts.tagline: Remove hidden characters. Keep your content pure.
posts.description: VelDetector is an online text cleaning tool that detects and removes hidden Unicode characters, invisible text watermarks, and unwanted formatting artifacts. Clean text copied from AI assistants, websites, documents, and Markdown editors in seconds.

posts.name: VocaLoop
posts.tagline: Mid-call data capture for voice agents
posts.description: Your voice agent asked for the email three times and still got it wrong. Or it gave up on the policy number. Or the address came back garbled. Tell your agent when to hand off, and Vocaloop does the rest: it generates a form for exactly the fields you're missing and delivers it mid-call over WhatsApp, SMS or email. The customer fills it while still talking, and clean structured data routes back into the conversation. No forms to build. Plugs into Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs and LiveKit.

posts.name: Calculate My Food
posts.tagline: Build any chain meal and see calories and macros.
posts.description: Free restaurant nutrition calculators for Chipotle, Starbucks, Subway, CAVA, Qdoba, Panda Express, and more. Build a meal and see calories and macros update live.

posts.name: Pelladio
posts.tagline: Chat with every AI model in one thread, no tab switching
posts.description: Hey so i'm building this cause i kept having like 4 tabs open just to ask the same thing to chatgpt, claude and gemini. pelladio lets you @ mention any model in the same chat instead, not those side by side comparison tools, one real conversation, models stay on the same context instead of answering in isolation. still building solo, no funding, waitlist's open if you want in early, would mean a lot

posts.name: Clixad
posts.tagline: Free AI coding agent for your terminal, no subscription
posts.description: Clixad is an AI coding agent for your terminal. Five models are free up to a daily limit, with no API key and no subscription. Need more? Answer short surveys to earn credits and spend them on premium models like Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.5. Made for people who code on the side or in bursts. Install with npm install -g clixad and sign in with GitHub.
